evals.prompt: Review the supplied technical or business manuscript for KDP preflight. Return the required five-section report, classify every finding, quote exact excerpts, propose minimally invasive revisions, and do not claim Amazon approval.
evals.expected_output: A structured conservative report covering blockers, content integrity, line editing, audience fit, KDP deliverables, evidence, revisions, limitations, and author confirmations.

evals.prompt: Preflight this technical book for KDP. Check outdated instructions, code or formula inconsistencies, missing prerequisites, unsafe commands, unsupported claims, citations, links, edition/version data, and AI disclosure. Treat unexecuted code and unverified external facts as needing review.
evals.expected_output: A report that separates inspected evidence from unverified technical claims and includes exact excerpts, severity, impact, and targeted revisions.

evals.prompt: Audit this business book for KDP readiness. Check arithmetic, projections, assumptions, financial/legal/tax claims, risk language, credentials, reader promise, actionability, references, disclaimers, and missing deliverables. Do not present the book as professional advice or guarantee market success.
evals.expected_output: A conservative evidence-based report with business-specific risks, author confirmations, line-edit patterns, audience-fit findings, and a complete checklist.
